physics_verification.model: Correct. In the ship frame the ISM is a parallel proton beam along -travel with kinetic-energy flux K (per unit face-on area; the gamma n density is inside K). A convex sphere's element with outward normal at theta from the travel direction intercepts K max(0, cos theta) per unit wall area (aft hemisphere shadowed). With local inelastic conversion eps and inward fraction f_in, the inward emittance is eps f_in K max(0, cos theta). Sphere mean of max(0, cos) = (1/2) int_0^1 mu dmu = 1/4 (also checked by 2e6-sample Monte Carlo: 0.25005), equivalently intercepted power K pi R^2 spread over 4 pi R^2. So pole = 4 x glowInwardFlux and glowInwardFlux (= eps fIn K / 4, medium.ail:89-90) is exactly the sphere mean of the profile. Canon higgs-bubble.md section 6 ('brightest at the forward pole', mean eps f_in K / 4) is satisfied.
physics_verification.package_values: Package tests assert 9.628776871706523e-5 and 1.1250843031053144 (from the 60-digit oracle); my float64 recomputation differs in the last ulp only (gamma via 1/sqrt vs rapidity form), well inside the 1e-12 tolerance.

physics_verification.clamp: cosTheta >= 1.0 -> 1.0 (so 1.0000000000000002 from a rounded dot product gives the pole, tested); cosTheta > 0.0 strict, so -0.0 and negatives give +0.0 (tested).

mutation_testing.summary: 9/9 killed. The clamp and NaN behaviours each hang on one test; acceptable for a one-line guard.

findings.issue: On ailang v0.52.0 a probe shows NaN >= 1.0 is false on both the interpreter and the strict VM, so the #1419 asymmetry the comment cites does not reproduce here.
findings.suggestion: Keep the NaN-first guard (correct regardless); re-check the #1419 workaround note at the next toolchain bump, as CLAUDE.md already prescribes.

findings.issue: glowDigest adds 1.0 only if NaN propagates; the NaN output's value is not folded in, so an engine divergence that yielded pole vs 0 for NaN cosTheta would leave the digest unchanged (confirmed with the no-NaN-arm mutant: 331.174... on both engines).
findings.suggestion: Optional: fold a sentinel that distinguishes 0, pole and NaN (e.g. add nanOut's clamped substitute), or leave as is since checkGlowNaN runs under both engines in the suite.

findings.severity: note (game side, M4.2/M4.6, not the package)
findings.issue: glowEmittanceAt is an emittance (W/m^2 of wall). The dome overlay needs scene radiance (W/m^2/sr); for a Lambertian wall that is M/pi. The design says 'converts W/m^2 to scene radiance with M1.5's photometric exposure' without naming the /pi (or chosen emission law).
findings.suggestion: Make the emittance-to-radiance step explicit and tested when M4.2's glow_profile mirror lands; G-M4-4's absolute check compares in W/m^2 so it is unaffected.

findings.issue: Negative phi returns negative emittance (kineticFlux is odd in phi). Same convention as glowInwardFlux and kineticFlux since 0.4.0; rapidity is >= 0 by package convention.
